voice.summary: Vaultline Docs says no politely and says why. It names the document and the owner, so a locked door reads like a clear rule rather than a failure.
dos: Name the document and who owns it
Offer the next step in the same message
Keep a steady, respectful tone even when refusing
donts: Blame the user for a permission gap

taglines: Ask nicely, we will open up
boilerplate: Vaultline Docs is a document workspace where every file has an owner and an access list, so teams can share sensitive material with clear permission requests.

microcopy.error: We could not send your request. Try again.

logo.note: A shield is the honest symbol for a product whose job is controlled access.
